text: DSH Session Toolkit（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：在会话头部提供工作区迁移和 Agent 预设切换。它通过 Host 路由复制会话历史到目标工作区，并可选择归档原会话；也能为已开始的会话重组预设。适合需要整理会话归属或调整会话 Agent 模式的 DSH Web 用户。需要 DSH Web 与 Host 服务，不需额外密钥。

DSH Session Toolkit adds workspace migration and Agent preset switching to the DSH Web conversation header. It copies history into a new session under another workspace, optionally archiving the source, and can switch presets after a session starts. Requires the DSH Web client and Host service.
想把当前会话连同历史移到另一个工作区。
能不能迁移会话后顺便归档旧会话？
让 DSH 把已经开始的会话切换到另一个 Agent 预设。
我想在聊天页面快速换工作区，不想丢掉会话记录。
I want to move a conversation and its history into another workspace.
How can I change the Agent preset after a session has already started?
Can I archive the old session when creating a copy under a different workspace?
DSH Session Toolkit 的功能「迁移会话到工作区」：把当前会话历史复制到所选工作区下的新会话，并可选择归档原会话。点击会话头部的工作区按钮后选择目标工作区即可触发。
DSH Session Toolkit 的功能「切换 Agent 预设」：为当前会话选择其他预设，已开始的会话也可切换，并从下一条请求生效。点击会话头部的预设按钮并选择预设即可。
DSH Session Toolkit 的功能「保留迁移时的模型选择」：迁移时读取源会话最后使用的模型选项，并将其用于新会话；若找不到则不附加模型选项。迁移操作自动执行。
DSH Session Toolkit 使用前须知：迁移会创建新的会话 ID，源会话历史保留在原处，是否归档源会话可在迁移时选择。
会话选错了工作区，想保留上下文搬过去继续用。

@qqiqiq/dsh-session-toolkit README · DSH Session Toolkit：Adds two buttons to the DSH conversation header:

| Button | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| ⇄ Workspace | Moves the current session into another registered workspace (optionally archiving the original) |
| ◈ Preset | Switches the Agent preset of the current session — **including sessions that already started** |

Both are things a browser half cannot do alone, which is why this plugin ships a host half as well.

@qqiqiq/dsh-session-toolkit README · Install：From the plugin market (search for "Session Toolkit"), or by hand:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/QqiqiQ/dsh-session-toolkit/releases/latest/download/dsh-session-toolkit.tgz
```

Then restart `dsh web`.

@qqiqiq/dsh-session-toolkit README · Why a host half is required：**Workspace membership is derived, not stored.** A session belongs to a workspace because the `cwd` in
its `session header` equals the workspace path — `dsh-workspace`'s `sessionIds` getter filters on that
condition every time, and `attachSession` refuses a session whose cwd does not match. The header is
immutable and no API rewrites `cwd`, so "moving" a session means **opening a continuation session in the
target directory that carries the whole history**:
section: Why a host half is required

@qqiqiq/dsh-session-toolkit README · Why a host half is required：```
sessionQuery.readSession
  → agents.create({ seed, inheritedEventCount,
                    meta: { cwd: targetPath, parentSession: sourceId, isSeeded: true } })
  → workspace.attachSession(newId)      // its header cwd is the target path, so it survives a restart
section: Why a host half is required

text:
@qqiqiq/dsh-session-toolkit README · Why a host half is required：The new session keeps fork provenance (`parentSession`, `isSeeded`, the `session/end-seed` marker),
because the harness has no "delete session" and no "change session id". It also starts on the model the
source last used — read from the last `model/selection` event, or, when the picker was never touched,
from the `config` of the last `request/header` event — because the persona prefix's `{{model}}` variable
only resolves from the options the Agent was created with.
section: Why a host half is required

text:
@qqiqiq/dsh-session-toolkit README · Why a host half is required：**`agentPresets.select` only accepts a blank session.** It throws `agent-preset/locked` once the session
has run a turn. The plugin tries that official path first, and only when it is refused does it rebind the
same Agent scope through `agentPresets.recompose(agent.ctx, id)` and write the `agent-preset/selected`
event that call would have written. History is not rewritten; projections and browser tabs follow.
section: Why a host half is required

text:
@qqiqiq/dsh-session-toolkit README · Channels：The browser half calls two host routes of this package with relative-URL `fetch` (deliberately not
session commands, so nothing lands in the session log as `command/run`):

- `POST /session-toolkit/migrate` — `{ sessionId, workspaceId, archiveSource?, agentPreset? }`
- `POST /session-toolkit/preset` — `{ sessionId, agentPreset }`

Both pass `connection.requestRejection` (login cookie / loopback / same-site checks) first, accept
`application/json` only, and cap the body at 64 KiB.

@qqiqiq/dsh-session-toolkit README · Known limits：- A migration produces a **new session id**; the original history is untouched. To get it back, unarchive
  the source session in its original workspace.
- Switching the preset changes the system prompt and tool catalog of the next request, so the provider's
  prefix cache is invalidated from the first token. While a turn is running the route answers
  `session-busy`.
- Switching the preset does not switch the model: model choice belongs to the session, not to the preset.
